name: Summer Heat
source:
Experience the ups and downs of summer class! Meet girls, earn their trust (or break their hearts) and practice your photography skill in the process. No matter what you choose, you'll feel the heat.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/naughtyfoxgames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
体验暑期班的酸甜苦辣！结识女孩，赢得她们的信任（或伤她们的心），并在此过程中练习你的摄影技巧。无论你选择什么，你都会感受到热量。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/naughtyfoxgames]Patreon[/url]]
